BooseDocumentation/BOOSE_App.html.summary: Namespace BOOSE_App Classes AppArray Array command class which creates an array variable for BOOSE.StoredProgram. This class creates both integer and real arrays and bypasses BOOSE restrictions. AppCanvas Class used for a drawable canvas via underlying bitmap. Supports basic drawing operations which are built upon in other classes. AppCommandFactory Factory class responsible for creating command objects for BOOSE application. Commands are linked to AppCanvas allowing drawing operations to be used avoiding their inherited restrictions. AppElse Else command class which executes code if a false value is passed into the stack by the if command. Bypasses BOOSE restrictions. AppEndFor End for command class which marks the end of a for loop. Determines whether loop should repeat or end, bypasses BOOSE restrictions. AppEndIf End if command class used to mark the end of an if block and updates runtimestack. Bypasses BOOSE restrictions. AppEndWhile End command class which marks the end of a while loop. Bypasses BOOSE restrictions. AppFor For command class which executes a loop by iterating an integer variable from a start value to an end value using an optional step. AppFor.ForRuntime Maintains a stack of active for commands. AppIf If command class which evalutes two expressions to set a boolean condition. Command execution is determined based on the boolean result. Bypasses BOOSE restrictions. AppIf.IfRuntime Maintains a stack of active if commands. AppInt Command class for handling integer variable assignments. Replaces BOOSE.Int functionality for runtime expression evaluation. AppPeek Peek command class which reads a value from an array and assigns it to an existing variable. Bypasses BOOSE restrictions. AppPoke Poke command which writes a value into an array element. Bypasses BOOSE restrictions. AppReal Command class for handling real (double) variable assignments. Replaces BOOSE.Real functionality for runtime expression evaluation. AppWhile While command class which evaluates two expressions to set a boolean condition. Command execution is repeatedly performed while the condition remains true. AppWhile.WhileRuntime Maintains a stack of active while commands. CircleCommand Command class for drawing circles onto canvas at current pen position. Bypasses BOOSE restrictions. Uses BOOSE.ICommand interface. CommandParser Parses user input into valid BOOSE commands. Works with command factory to create command objects and stores them in BOOSE.StoredProgram for execution. DrawToCommand Command class for drawing a line on canvas from current pen position. Form1 Form1 operates as the main class for the application. It provides a windows form GUI to store and execute user commands, which interact with the drawable canvas. MoveToCommand Command class for moving pen on canvas without drawing. PenCommand Command class used for setting the pen colour used for drawing on canvas. RectangleCommand Command class for drawing rectangles onto canvas at current pen position. Bypasses BOOSE restrictions. WriteCommand Command class for drawing text onto canvas at current pen position. Uses BOOSE.ICommand interface.
